author: Midnightstorm
body:
Hihi. Well, whilst playing Nebula, I came across two hackers! One was flying and the other had aura/aim I believe.

BenjyDoesMC
Hacking
Flying

NeoxitPvP
Hacking
Kill aura/Aim

This video contains both hackers, I will list the times of the proof.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AlZu6rRjg6I

BenjyDoesMC is seen flying from 0:53-1:05

NeoxitPvP is seen swinging at his own teammate from 2:05-2:10
The player is also seen with kill aura/aim and antiknockback from 2:40-2:43
Player seen swinging his head and hitting another player from 2:55-2:58
Player seen going on a killing spree with his head swinging and with aim from3:02-3:15

Thank you for taking the time to read this and keep Avicus safe from hackers! <3 ly guys
